name: trysend
algorithm: Send without waiting on one task: reps rounds of 1,040 tries into a channel of capacity 1,024 (the last 16 given back), then 1,024 receives; the checksum adds every value received and given back (README.md).

skip.zig: no channel in Zig's std: std.Thread has a Mutex, a Condition and a ResetEvent, no bounded queue
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; the task has no other integer arithmetic

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries; TrySend's correctness is std/core/tests_sync.mk's three blocks named "TrySend ..."
